name: Zechariah (son of Jeberechiah)
title: Witness for the prophet Isaiah
summary: Zechariah, son of Jeberechiah, was one of the reliable witnesses the prophet Isaiah took with him when he recorded the prophetic sign about Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

keyEvents.title: Witness for Isaiah
keyEvents.description: Isaiah took Uriah the priest and Zechariah, son of Jeberechiah, as reliable witnesses for the prophetic sign.
